text: cortex R5 x walk: a multi-candidate walk that reaches an adjudicated-not-clean state and moves on (restoring the found bytes for the next attempt) now puts that state's graded bytes back when it ends reporting the adjudication (exit 27), so the file, accepted.sha256 and the deciding verdict agree; if they cannot be put back the run fails closed (exit 22, accepted: null). Exit 27's deciding digest is the adjudicated passed:false event's, never a later candidate's regressed hidden pass.
